Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Ermesinda of Bigorre’s father as “Bernard II, Count of Bigorre,” conflating numbering and confusing Bernard-Roger (her actual father) with Bernard II (her brother). This genealogical misinterpretation introduced an incorrect target ancestor and reflects a failure to correctly map relationships before verification, leading to confusion despite later correction.
